english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for wanting to know, ask questions, or investigate.
Use this when “interested” specifically means curious and wanting to know more, rather than simply keen on something.

examples.english: I'm curious why you came back so early.
examples.traditional: 我好奇你點解咁早返嚟。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 hou3 kei4 nei5 dim2 gaai2 gam3 zou2 faan1 lei4

examples.english: I’m interested in why they didn’t go to work.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 hou3 kei4 keoi5 dim2 gaai2 m4 faan1 gung1
